collection.title: MODIS/Aqua Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG V061

access: Earthdata Login (environment token); LP DAAC cloud OPeNDAP DAP4 server-side subset of LST_Day_CMG, one month at a time, in memory (no raw file kept)
regrid: mean of valid 0.05 degree cells in each 20 x 20 block (1 degree), kept if >= 200 of 400 valid; decoded once: K = 0.02 * stored (stored 0 = fill, valid 7500-65535), then K - 273.15
note: Raw granules are not kept; only the 1-degree monthly derivative is shipped. No trend statistic is computed in the build.
